layout: Prompted after auto-check-out. Light bg. Centered content. Desktop: split with session recap on right.
elements: HEADER: 'How was your session?' in navy h2, centered
SESSION RECAP: Buddy photo + name + 'Today, 07:00-08:00 at [gym]' in small slate text
5 large stars, horizontally centered. Interactive (tap to rate 1-5). Stars are outlined (gray) when unselected, filled orange (#FF8A34) when selected
Label below: 'Tap to rate' or 'Great!' (dynamic based on rating)
Textarea/multiline input. 10px radius, 1.5px border, min 3 lines height
Upload area: dashed border box, camera icon, 'Add photo proof' text
Max 3 photos. Uploaded photos shown as small thumbnails with X remove button
SKIP: 'Do this later' link in slate below CTA
THANK YOU STATE: Card collapses, green checkmark, 'Thank you for your review!'
notes: Make rating stars large and easy to tap. Photo upload is optional. Skip link for users who want to review later.
